module: Functions shared by the modal operators (rotate, scale, translate) of the Easy Select tool: starting a transform session on the selection, handling X/Y/Z axis constraints (world/local, exclusion with Shift), numeric input, confirm/cancel (Enter or left click in the viewport = confirm; Esc or right click = cancel), world-to-screen projection, and drawing the HUD and indicators near the mouse.
notes: The session anchor is the last object of editor.selection.object; the pivot is the center of editor.objectSelectionBBox if valid, otherwise the anchor position.
Pressing the same axis key twice (same exclusion state) toggles local/world space; another axis recreates the constraint with the default space.
The "state" object returned by begin contains pivot, camera, startRay, startMouse, worldAxes, localAxes, constraint, defaultLocal, numeric; operators add their own fields to it.

normalized.desc: Normalizes a vector; returns fallback if its length is <= 0.0001.

returns.desc: {origin = vec3, direction = normalized vec3} or nil

rayPlanePoint.desc: Intersection of a ray with a plane.

returns.desc: Intersection point, nil if the ray is parallel (|denominator| <= 0.0001) or there is no ray

begin.desc: Opens the transform session on the selection and creates the operator state. Returns nil if there is no anchor, no camera/ray, or if transformSession.begin fails.

updateConstraint.desc: Reads the X/Y/Z keys and updates state.constraint = {axis, exclude, localSpace}.

allowExclude.desc: If true, holding Shift means "exclude this axis"

returns.desc: true if the constraint changed this frame

setLocalSpace.desc: Sets the default local/world space and applies it to the active constraint; then ignores the top row key 4 for numeric input on the next update.

axes.desc: Current axis set (localAxes if the constraint is in local space, otherwise worldAxes).

activeAxis.desc: Vector of the constrained axis, or nil without constraint.

updateNumeric.desc: Updates the numeric input (transformNumericInput) and returns the entered value.

returns.desc: "cancel" (Esc/right click), "confirm" (Enter, numpad Enter, left click in the viewport) or nil

finish.desc: Ends the session: confirm calls transformSession.finish (if nothing is committed, returns "cancel"), otherwise transformSession.cancel; restores the cursor.

projectToScreen.desc: Projects a world point to screen coordinates. nil if the point is behind the camera or nearly in its plane (depth <= 0.0001).

camera.desc: Camera context (pos, forward, right, up, halfTan, aspect, viewportX/Y, width, height)

drawInteractionHint.desc: Hides the system cursor and draws at the cursor a dot with chevrons (rotate: tangents; scale: radial; translate: 4 directions) and, except for translate, a dotted line from the pivot to the mouse.

pivotScreen.desc: Pivot in screen coordinates (nothing is drawn if nil)

setInteractionCursorHidden.desc: Hides or re-shows the cursor via the Canvas object (setCursorVisible).

drawHud.desc: Draws a two-line panel near the mouse (line 1: prefix + details; line 2: help), kept within the viewport.

border.desc: imgui U32 color of the border
